title: Learning How a Body Moves: Few-Shot Body Inference for Visual World Models of Animated Characters
abstract: arXiv:2611.28842v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Two visually identical animated characters can respond differently to the same action command because their body dynamics differ. For example, a stiff blob and its bouncy twin reach different heights when both receive the jump command. Given only the first frame and the action command, a visual world model has no information to distinguish these twins, because their initial appearances are identical. We therefore propose an in-context world model that encodes clips of a character's other actions into a body representation, using a contrastive loss to separate look-alike characters. We introduce ToonTwins, a benchmark of 144 2D cartoon characters that run, jump, fall, turn and crouch. Its characters form look-alike groups of four that differ only in their dynamics profile, and we also evaluate the model on 32 animated animals from DeformingThings4D. Even with a body code from these clips, the latent pixel world model we tested recovered

translated_title: 学习身体如何运动：面向动画角色视觉世界模型的少样本身体推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.28842v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：两个视觉上完全相同的动画角色，可能因身体动力学不同而对同一动作指令产生不同的响应。例如，一个僵硬的团状角色和它的弹性孪生角色在收到跳跃指令时会跳到不同的高度。仅给定第一帧和动作指令，视觉世界模型无法区分这两个孪生角色，因为它们的初始外观完全相同。因此，我们提出了一种上下文内（in-context）世界模型，它将角色其他动作的视频片段编码为身体表示，并使用对比损失来区分外观相似的角色。我们介绍了 ToonTwins，一个包含 144 个 2D 卡通角色的基准数据集，这些角色能够奔跑、跳跃、下落、转身和下蹲。其角色构成若干四人一组的外观相似组，组内角色仅在动力学特征上有所差异；我们还在来自 DeformingThings4D 的 32 个动画动物上对该模型进行了评估。即使利用这些片段得到的身体编码，我们所测试的潜在像素世界模型也仅恢复了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出一种上下文内世界模型，通过编码角色其他动作片段生成身体表示并结合对比损失，使视觉世界模型能够区分外观完全相同但身体动力学不同的动画角色，同时发布了包含144个2D卡通角色的ToonTwins基准数据集。
en_tdlr: An in-context world model that encodes clips of a character's other actions into a body representation via a contrastive loss enables visual world models to distinguish visually identical animated characters with different dynamics, introduced alongside the ToonTwins benchmark of 144 2D cartoon characters.
